expectations.note: The candidate never exercised the live VM: its event trail contains source inspection/editing and failed flutter commands, but no drive.py or ext.nothingness playback calls; the live extension session was launched only for the judge's independent re-check.

Independent live captures showed fixture playback, then isPlaying=false while paused, then isPlaying=true after resume; the app responded correctly even though the candidate did not perform these calls itself.
Independent three-track queue captures showed next changing currentIndex from 0/path 01 to 1/path 02; the queue remained multi-track and active playback continued.
Independent live seek while playing moved the active track position to about 35.0s after requesting 30s, within the rubric tolerance and clearly beyond the pre-seek position.
The candidate's final report claims an automated play/next/previous/seek/pause sequence but provides no state-read observations; its event trail has no corresponding extension calls or outputs.
The app behaved normally during the independent smoke checks, but the candidate made an unrequested 39-line source change to lib/main.dart rather than only producing non-functional artifacts.

The candidate's flutter invocations failed with command-not-found and it never launched or recovered the app before reporting completion; the later live app was started by the judge, not recovered by the candidate.
